SELECT 
  pq.question_id,
  pq.question_type,
  pq.difficulty,
  pq.question_text,
  pq.question_data,
  pq.marks_available,
  pq.answer_type,
  pq.mark_scheme,
  pq.working_required,
  pq.command_word,
  pq.hint_text,
  pq.specification_ref,
  pq.exam_board,
  t.topic_name
FROM practice_questions pq
JOIN topics t ON pq.topic_id = t.topic_id
WHERE pq.topic_id = $1 
  AND pq.difficulty = $2
  AND ($3::varchar IS NULL OR pq.question_type = $3)
ORDER BY RANDOM()
LIMIT $4

SELECT 
  pq.question_id,
  pq.question_text,
  pq.marks_available,
  pq.correct_answer,
  pq.acceptable_answers,
  pq.mark_scheme,
  pq.command_word,
  pq.explanation,
  pq.common_errors,
  t.topic_name
FROM practice_questions pq
JOIN topics t ON pq.topic_id = t.topic_id
WHERE pq.question_id = $1

-- Insert practice attempt
INSERT INTO student_practice_attempts (
  student_id,
  question_id,
  student_answer,
  marks_awarded,
  marks_possible,
  is_correct,
  feedback,
  time_taken_seconds,
  hint_used,
  attempted_at
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, NOW())
RETURNING attempt_id;

-- Update student stats
UPDATE students SET
  total_practice_questions = total_practice_questions + 1,
  xp_points = xp_points + $10,
  last_activity_date = CURRENT_DATE,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE student_id = $1;
